title: Controlled direct-backend fallback
summary: Provided explicit controls for interconnect actions that require direct Configuration Engine execution.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2026-09-16. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Implemented controlled direct-Configuration Engine fallback with content-bound execution and supporting evidence.
Enabled agent-led configuration creation and import/modify/diagnose workflows with backend fallback.
Added content-bound fallback script admission using AST checks, protected-harness fingerprints, public API inventories and explicit rejection of unresolved gaps or prohibited dynamic calls.
Controlled backend fallback is distinct from checkpoint rollback and runtime routing; script admission is not a claim of a general secure Python sandbox.

notes: Fallback is a separate mechanism from checkpoint rollback and current/legacy Python runtime routing; a rollback hash result is not a fallback benchmark.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
